question: Mine (gold/iron/coal) income rate application: is produce=13 per peasant per minute?
probes: Follow resincome counter application in player.script / country.script to see the time base.
resolution: Resolved from data/scripts/lib/player.script _player_ProcessResourceIncome: income counter is produce-sum (13 per peasant in a mine); applied per tick as resincome*gc_time_to_frames*deltatime/250 (speed=256/1.024) => 13*32/250 = 1.664 units/s per peasant (~100/min). Consumption: resconsume*32/20000 per second (player.script _player_ProcessResourceConsume).
